name: obsideo-mcp
description: MCP server for Obsideo: S3-compatible storage that is encrypted client-side by default, with continuous cryptographic possession proofs you can verify yourself. Instant no-email trial, self-serve signup (12 GB free, no card), put/get/ls/rm/verify/usage tools. Runs on YOUR machine; credentials and keys never leave it.

scripts.build:mcpb: npm run build && esbuild dist/index.js --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=mcpb/server/index.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire as __mcpbRequire } from 'module'; const require = __mcpbRequire(import.meta.url);" && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('package.json','mcpb/package.json')" && node scripts/mcpb-check.mjs
